description: Appearance, updates and the data VibeHub keeps on this computer.
contentUpdated: The catalog and guides were updated.
manualUpdates: Automatic update checks are not available in this version. Use the check buttons above.
notificationsUnavailable: System notifications are not available in this version.
notificationsHint: Allow verified, active offers to send a system notification when you open Offers. Permission is requested only when you enable this option.
notificationPermissionDenied: Windows notification permission was not granted. Enable notifications in Windows settings, then try again.
cacheHint: Removes downloaded catalog and guide content. Your preferences, connections and keys stay saved. The bundled catalog remains available offline.
resetHint: Resets language, theme, launch preferences and the welcome flow. Native proxy profiles and credentials stay saved.
resetConfirm: Reset your language, appearance and preferred launch modes and show the welcome flow again? Proxy profiles, model connections and stored keys will remain saved.
credentialsHint: Review saved model connections and older provider keys before deleting them. Proxy passwords are not included.
credentialsConfirm: The listed model connections, their keys and listed older provider keys will be permanently deleted. Proxy passwords are not affected. Deleted keys cannot be restored by VibeHub.
nothingToDelete: No saved model connections or older keys were found.
credentialsDone: The selected model connections and keys were deleted.
partialDelete: {{count}} items were deleted. The following items still need attention; only the remaining selection will be retried.

deleteErrors.vaultDeleteFailed: The Windows credential vault could not delete this key. Try again after checking access to the vault.
deleteErrors.legacyDeleteBlocked: Kept until the older provider key is deleted, to prevent the key from returning.
deleteErrors.connectionDeleteFailed: The connection could not be completely removed. Refresh the inventory and retry.
